metadata.title: Message Security and Integrity

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring integration messages are authentic, authorized, and protected against tampering.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Message authentication, authorization, signing, integrity validation, and confidentiality mechanisms for integration messaging.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for enforcing message authenticity, authorization, and integrity across integration channels.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Message security assumes baseline integration identity, ownership, boundary control, and accountability.

metadata.remarks: Message Security and Integrity defines trust properties required to ensure that integration messages are sent by authorized producers, assert permitted claims, and are not modified in transit. This pattern focuses on assertion-level trust rather than transport delivery guarantees.

components.title: Message Producer Authentication
components.description: Verifies the identity of the system emitting a message.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid service credentials to impersonate an authorized producer.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong authentication for non-human message senders.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Message producers are authenticated prior to message acceptance.

components.title: Message Authorization and Assertion Control
components.description: Ensures producers are authorized to assert specific message types, topics, or claims.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted integration paths to assert unauthorized commands or facts.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Authorization controls that restrict what assertions a producer may emit.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Authorization checks validate whether a producer may emit a given message.
Message assertion privileges follow least privilege principles.

components.title: Message Integrity Protection
components.description: Prevents unauthorized modification of messages during transmission or handling.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Tampering with message content to alter meaning or side effects.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Integrity validation to detect message modification.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity mechanisms detect unauthorized modification of messages.

components.title: Message Confidentiality (Where Required)
components.description: Protects message contents from unauthorized disclosure when confidentiality is required.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Eavesdropping on message contents in transit.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Encryption of messages in transit or at rest.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cryptographic mechanisms protect message confidentiality where required.

components.title: Message Security Observability
components.description: Provides visibility into message security decisions and violations for monitoring and investigation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of evidence related to message security violations.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging of security decisions for integration messages.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Audit review supports investigation of unauthorized message activity.
